notes: Swap rules for recipe ingredients (docs/AI_FOOD_LIBRARY_PLAN.md §5). Keys are recipe-table keys (server-assets/nutrition/ingredient-table.json). basis: volume (same amount and unit), weight (same grams), sodium or fat (the amount that gives the same sodium or fat, from the food library figures; never with a stand-in key, whose figures are another food), factor (grams times factor), leave (leave it out). keeps: the roles of the original line the swap serves (default: all its roles). failsIn: recipe contexts it does not work in. profiles.contains: exclusions a name does not show (added to what the name shows). note or step: the one change shown, in English and Simplified Chinese. reason: why it works, for staff. Order matters: the first three for a line are shown, the rest under More options. Drafted by QuinTaste from culinary practice and the library figures, 2 Nov 2026; diet, allergen and nutrient effects are worked out by code, never written here.
